title: OpenAI-Compatible Chat Completions Request Configuration
description:
Configuration file for customizing chat completions requests of OpenAI-compatible APIs (Translation only, not TTS).

- 'default' applies to all models, 'models' entries are merged into (and override) 'default'.
- The request 'messages' field is always forced by the plugin and cannot be configured.
- The request body 'model' field may be configured to override the model id selected in the UI (useful when a provider exposes the same model under a different id).
- String values in 'request.body' and 'request.headers' may reference the placeholders ${TEXT}, ${SOURCE_LANGUAGE} and ${TARGET_LANGUAGE}. Use $${...} to escape a literal ${...}.

$schema.description: Reference to this JSON Schema. Added automatically by the plugin when editing the config file.

default.description: The default request configuration, shared by all models.

models.description: Per-model request configurations, keyed by the request model id (the selected model's id, or the custom model name). Each entry is merged into 'default', overriding the same keys.

modelConfig.description: Request customization for a model. The request body 'messages' field cannot be configured and is always ignored.

languageMapping.description:
Maps plugin languages to provider-specific language definitions.
Keys are either the Lang enum names (e.g. 'CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED') or the language codes (e.g. 'zh-CN'); values are the language strings used in requests and prompt templates. Unmapped languages fall back to the language's English name.

prompt.description: Prompt template file paths, relative to this config file or absolute. If not configured, the default prompt templates are used.

translator.description: Path to the translator prompt template file (Apache Velocity template).

document.description: Path to the document translator prompt template file (Apache Velocity template).

request.description: HTTP request customization for the chat completions API.

headers.description: Extra HTTP request headers. String values may reference ${TEXT}, ${SOURCE_LANGUAGE} and ${TARGET_LANGUAGE}.

body.description: Extra request body fields (any JSON value). String values may reference ${TEXT}, ${SOURCE_LANGUAGE} and ${TARGET_LANGUAGE}. The 'model' field overrides the model id selected in the UI (useful when a provider exposes the same model under a different id). The 'messages' field is ignored, and 'stream' is always forced to false since streaming is not supported.
